_doc: PUBLIC EXECUTIONS (systems/executions.js). The condemned wait on a list for your word (Executions.condemn: a trial's 'scaffold' verdict, a crushed revolt's leader, a broken rebel, an outlaw you caught, a captive, another system's prisoner). You choose the PLACE (a seat you rule, or the town of the crime), the METHOD (methods: who it suits — ranks; crimes it is for — crimes; faith it needs — faith, by the realm faith's stance from data/maiming.json faiths) or a MERCY, and whether to PROCLAIM it (proclaimDays ahead: a bigger crowd, and anyone in town may come) or do it here and now. THE CROWD: size = the town's population x crowd.share by town type (x crowd.unproclaimed when not proclaimed, x crowd.lordPresent when you stand there). MOOD (-100..100) = the crime's bloodlust (crimes.*.crowd) - popularity x crowd.popularity + (town happiness - 50) x crowd.happiness + your realm reputation x crowd.reputation - crowd.innocentSense when the condemned is innocent + the method's horror (methods.*.horror, waived when the crime suits it) + crowd.highborn when a lord dies. moods: the bands. DISRUPTION (hash rolls, no shared dice): a rescue (disruption.rescue: base + per kin/House/band, + per popularity, + angry crowd; x present when you stand there; success: escapes), a riot (an angry crowd: disruption.riot), the rope breaks (hanging only: disruption.rope — the crowd cries a sign of God; the condemned goes back on your list). EFFECTS: effects.* are Petitions effects at the place (happiness, loyalty, prestige, stability, court…): kill (always), crowd.<mood> (by the crowd's mood), method.<id>, innocent, mercy.<id>; fear: Traits deeds (cruelty, dread, mercy) x methods.*.fear/cruelty; town deterrence: a public death cows the town's thieves for fearDays (npcTheft reads Executions.deterrence); lords: lordDeeds; kin vengeance: nemesis scores by rank; martyr: martyr.* (an innocent or popular victim's cult: a shrine in town, pilgrims' coin from the realm's capital, unrest against the killer weekly while it lasts). THE TRUTH: an innocent executed (not by a trial, which surfaces its own) is found out surfaceDays later: effects.truth, the kin, the lords, the cult. AI REALMS: ai.* — each realm's capital hangs (burns, beheads) its condemned now and then: world notices only for the highborn and the burnings; anyone in town on the day can join the crowd.

corruption.label: robbing the purse they were set over

adultery.label: adultery and the shame of the House

behead.label: The axe
behead.desc: A clean death on the block, as the highborn are owed.

hang.label: The rope
hang.desc: The gallows in the square, the common death.

burn.label: The stake
burn.desc: Burned alive for heresy, where the faith allows it.

quarter.label: Drawn and quartered
quarter.desc: Hanged, drawn and quartered, the death for treason.

flay.label: Flayed alive
flay.desc: Skinned alive on the scaffold, the death for a traitor or an official who robbed the purse he was set over. The skin is yours to hang on the gate or stretch over the judge's chair.
flay.crimesWhy: Only for treason or an official's corruption.

pardon.label: Pardon
pardon.desc: Let them go, before the crowd. Mercy, or weakness, as the crowd takes it.

exile.label: Exile
exile.desc: Out of the realm, never to come back on pain of death.

cloister.label: The cloister
cloister.desc: Shorn and sent to a monastery for life: dead to the world, and no blood on your hands.

maim.label: The knife instead
maim.desc: Spare the life; take a hand (systems/maiming.js).

mines.label: The mines instead
mines.desc: Spare the life for a long term of hard labour, where the realm's law allows (systems/penalLabour.js).

galleys.label: The galleys instead
galleys.desc: Spare the life for a long term at the oar, where the realm's law allows (systems/penalLabour.js).

street._doc: The scaffold on the town's street map (world/scaffolds.js lays the prop in the square from the proclamation to the day: gallows for hang/quarter, the block for the axe, the stake for burning) and its crowd (world/innerMap/scaffoldCrowd.js): on the day, in hours [from, to), share of the grown townsfolk stand packed in rows before it, facing it; on the days before, gawkers of them stop by in gawkHours. lines (and cruel, for a burning or a quartering) are muttered over their heads on the day; gawk on the days before. {name}: the condemned.
lines: I never thought I'd see {name} up there.
My father saw the last one. He never slept the same.
Hats off when they bring them out.
cruel: I'll not watch this. I'll not.
They say you can hear it from the river.
gawk: Day after tomorrow, the crier says.
I don't like to walk past it.

guestRight._doc: A ward raised at your court (Raising wards, a rival House's child) put to death: guest-right broken. effects: Petitions effects at the place; otherHousesFeud: every other rival House's feud with you rises (and they remember guestRightBroken); lordDeed: every realm's lord remembers it; cruelty, deceit: Traits deeds.
guestRight.line: A ward raised under your own roof: guest-right is broken, and every House and every lord will hear of it.

lastGuilty: I did what they say. God have mercy on me, for I had none.
Make it quick, headsman. I have kept the crowd waiting long enough.
Pray for me. I never prayed for anyone.
Tell my mother I was sorry. Tell no one else.
lastInnocent: I never did it. God knows it, and so will you, {lord}.
You hang an innocent today. Remember my face.
I forgive the crowd. I do not forgive {lord}.
Look at me, all of you. I am no {crime}. I am one of you.
lastDefiant: Do it, then. My blood will water your fields with curses.
{lord}, I will be waiting for you.
Long after you are dust, they will sing of me in {town}.
lastHighborn: I die as I lived: of better blood than the one who sends me.
My House will remember this day, {lord}. Every day of it.
Strike clean. I am owed that much.
lastSilent: *says nothing, and looks at the crowd until the end*
lines.scene: {crowd} came to the {place} of {town} to see {name} die for {crime}. The crowd was {mood}.
lines.rope: The rope breaks. {name} drops to the boards alive, and the crowd cries out: a sign of God!
lines.rescue: As {name} mounts the scaffold, men burst from the crowd, cut the bonds and are gone into the lanes with {him}.
lines.rescueFailed: Men rush the scaffold to free {name}; the guards cut them down, and the sentence stands.
lines.riot: The crowd will not have it: stones fly, the guards are driven back, stalls burn.
lines.cult: In {town} they say {name} was a saint. Flowers and candles gather where the scaffold stood; pilgrims come.
lines.truth: The truth comes out: {name} was innocent of {crime}. {town} will not forget whose word sent {him} to die.
